method: npm registry for version/license; SHIPPED TYPE DECLARATIONS read from an actual install of @mcp-ui/client@7.1.1 for API surface. Documentation prose was NOT treated as authoritative — doing so in the first draft produced a recommendation for a component this version does not export.
evaluation_criteria: API surface verified against shipped .d.ts, not docs
deployment constraints imposed on the scaffolder
precedent in this repo (phases 7 and 8 pin external protocol packages exact)
transitive_evaluation_note: Transitive packages (@modelcontextprotocol/sdk, zod) are evaluated on license, version and stability because they enter the scaffolded app's dependency graph and a scaffolder ships them to every consumer. They are NOT evaluated on suitability, since the choice is not ours — adopting @mcp-ui/client adopts them.

candidates.rationale: The renderer the phase exists to integrate, and the package the operator's G-7 go decision named. Post-1.0 is the strongest API-stability signal of the three host phases.
candidates.critical_finding: UIResourceRenderer is NOT exported. dist/src/components/ contains only AppRenderer.d.ts and AppFrame.d.ts. Upstream docs still show UIResourceRenderer for 'legacy hosts'; it was removed before 7.x. This overturned the first draft of D-003 and is the reason post-1.0 does not justify relaxing the exact pin.
imposed_constraints: SandboxConfig.url is REQUIRED on AppFrameProps — a hosted sandbox proxy HTML is mandatory, there is no in-process rendering path
default sandbox permissions are 'allow-scripts allow-same-origin allow-forms' — the permissive pairing; safe only if the proxy is genuinely cross-origin

candidates.rationale: Not optional. Declared as a hard dependency of @mcp-ui/client ('^1.2.0') and re-exported by it (AppBridge, PostMessageTransport). The first draft's 'defer ext-apps' was never an available option — it arrives transitively regardless, so pinning it explicitly is the honest choice.
candidates.note: Also the most recently published package in this space, which was assess F-3's signal that the MCP org's own extension may be where the centre of gravity is moving.

candidates.rationale: Declared dependency of @mcp-ui/client ('^1.27.1'). Supplies EmbeddedResource, CallToolResult, ReadResourceResult and the other request/result types AppRendererProps is written against, so the host will almost certainly import it for types. Pin explicitly if so.
candidates.note: isUIResource is typed against EmbeddedResource from this SDK — the evidence in D-002 that the ui:// resource rides inside the tool-result content array.

candidates.rationale: Declined on a technical ground, not staleness: createUIResource constructs a small JSON object. The mock emits that shape from inside Vite middleware; adding a dependency to build a literal buys nothing. The G-1 schema becomes the contract instead — and unlike a dependency, a schema can be validated against upstream's shape in a test.
candidates.staleness_note: ~6 months since publish was assess F-4's strongest evidence AGAINST proceeding. Declining it removes that risk from the phase's dependency surface rather than absorbing it.

candidates.rationale: Declared dependency of @mcp-ui/client. No direct use planned.
candidates.note: The client's ^3 range holds zod a MAJOR version behind the registry latest (4.5.4). A scaffolded app wanting zod 4 for its own validation will hit a duplicate install or a peer conflict. Worth a line in the scaffolder README; not a blocker.

rejected_repo_options.rationale: Speaks stdio JSON-RPC (Cargo.toml:3); a browser cannot. Bridging needs a second process plus an HTTP bridge. Separately, a template forge is a poor home for a demo UI resource. Method coverage was never the obstacle — it already implements initialize/tools/list/tools/call.
Largest cost of the options, no scaffolder precedent, and unnecessary given D-002.

rejected_repo_options.option: follow scaffold-react-vite-axum.sh as the backend precedent
rejected_repo_options.rationale: Surfaced by assess round-3 review and worth checking, but it is a BUILD-TIME server embedding dist/ via rust-embed for production — not a dev-time API. The applicable precedent is phase-7's vite-plugin-agui-mock.ts.

chosen_transport.rationale: Direct transposition of scaffold-react-vite-agui.sh's vite-plugin-agui-mock.ts, which already registers itself into vite.config.ts idempotently. Answers POST /api/mcp with JSON-RPC initialize / tools/list / tools/call, returning an embedded ui:// resource. Keeps the smoke gate a single-process pnpm dev, as in both prior host phases.
chosen_transport.unresolved: The sandbox proxy may still require a genuine second origin for allow-same-origin to be safe (D-003, D-006). If so, 'no second process' survives but 'single origin' does not. Spec must settle it.
